create_prompt_insert_new_prompt: create a prompt by calling insert_new_prompt with a user_id and PromptForm containing command, title, and content
get_prompts_list: get all prompts ordered by timestamp descending with associated user information using get_prompts
get_prompt_by_command: retrieve a single prompt by its unique command string using get_prompt_by_command
update_prompt_by_command: update a prompt's title, content, and access_control by its command string using update_prompt_by_command
delete_prompt_by_command: delete a prompt record by its command string using delete_prompt_by_command
